name: Mirror Lake
summary: Novice Alliance mages in Stormwind's Mage Quarter are sent to sample Mirror Lake's waters for magical contamination. Jennea Cannon sends them southwest of the city gates to test the waterfall spray.

sections.title: Ley Lines and Shifting Currents
sections.body: Azeroth's arcane currents were shaken by conflicts from the opening of the Dark Portal through the Third War and the battle at Mount Hyjal. Those shocks tore ancient currents from their stable channels. In Stormwind's Wizard's Sanctum, magi like Jennea Cannon watch the changes closely. They fear that displaced arcane power could reach the wilderness and corrupt local ecosystems.

sections.title: Testing the Waters
sections.body: Mirror Lake lies beneath the cliffs southwest of the Stormwind gates and is a primary natural reservoir fed by mountain falls. The surrounding countryside depends on its waters. Jennea sends novice mages with a glass flask to the waterfall's base, where they collect fresh spray. The Sanctum can then use scrying and reagent tests to learn whether wild magic is seeping into the public water supply.

faq.q: Why does Jennea Cannon want a water sample from Mirror Lake?
faq.answer: Conflicts across Azeroth have ruptured natural ley currents. Jennea Cannon fears unsettled arcane energies are reaching the water table around Stormwind and could harm anyone who drinks from the lake.
Mirror Lake lies in northwestern Elwynn Forest, against the high bluffs southwest of Stormwind's main gates. The sample comes from the pool at the foot of its waterfall.

faq.q: What happens if the water is tainted?
faq.answer: Jennea fears that drinking magically tainted water for too long could harm those who depend on the lake. The precise effects are not known.
Novice Alliance mages in training undertake this assignment as one of their earliest field studies for the Wizard's Sanctum.

faq.q: Does this quest lead to further investigations?
faq.answer: The direct initial task begun with Jennea Cannon's summons ends here. It gives the apprentice their first formal mage implement and establishes their duty to watch for magical disturbances across the realm.

faq.q: What caused the magical currents to destabilize in the first place?
faq.answer: Jennea traces the changed currents to the world's great mystic struggles, but names no specific battle or event.

angles.text: As a Mage, you move from study in the Wizard's Sanctum to investigating arcane phenomena in the world. This work brings your first dedicated mage staff or off-hand orb.
As a Human, you know Mirror Lake feeds Elwynn's farmlands and waterways, so its purity matters to Stormwind's citizens.
As an Alliance member, you can help the Wizard's Sanctum magi protect Elwynn's natural resources and the kingdom's heart.
